args.topic: FEC independent expenditures by candidate cycle total

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows, SUM(amount) AS total_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT candidate_id) AS distinct_candidates, MIN(amount) AS min_amt, MAX(amount) AS max_amt FROM fec.independent_expenditures WHERE election_year = 2026
SELECT candidate_name, candidate_id, spender_name, amount, support_oppose, amendment_indicator FROM fec.independent_expenditures WHERE election_year = 2026 ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT spender_name, amount, support_oppose, candidate_state, candidate_office FROM fec.independent_expenditures WHERE candidate_id = 'S6TX00479' AND election_year = 2026 ORDER BY amount DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(amount) AS total, COUNT(DISTINCT spender_id) AS n_committees, SUM(CASE WHEN support_oppose='S' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS support_amt, SUM(CASE WHEN support_oppose='O' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS oppose_amt FROM fec.independent_expenditures WHERE candidate_id = 'S6TX00479' AND election_year = 2026
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(amount) AS total, COUNT(DISTINCT candidate_id) AS distinct_candidates FROM fec.independent_expenditures WHERE election_year = 2026 AND candidate_name <> 'Bettis, Shawn'

SELECT candidate_name, candidate_id, SUM(amount) AS total FROM fec.independent_expenditures WHERE election_year = 2026 AND candidate_name <> 'Bettis, Shawn' GROUP BY candidate_name, candidate_id ORDER BY total DESC FETCH FIRST 15 ROWS ONLY

SELECT spender_name, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(amount) AS total FROM fec.independent_expenditures WHERE election_year = 2026 AND candidate_name <> 'Bettis, Shawn' GROUP BY spender_name ORDER BY total DESC FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(amount) AS total FROM fec.independent_expenditures WHERE election_year = 2026 AND candidate_name <> 'Bettis, Shawn' AND amount > 5000000
SELECT amendment_indicator, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(amount) AS total FROM fec.independent_expenditures WHERE election_year = 2026 AND candidate_name <> 'Bettis, Shawn' GROUP BY amendment_indicator

SELECT filing_id, transaction_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM fec.independent_expenditures WHERE election_year = 2026 AND candidate_name <> 'Bettis, Shawn' GROUP BY filing_id, transaction_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(candidate_id, candidate_name)) AS distinct_all, SUM(CASE WHEN candidate_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_id_rows FROM fec.independent_expenditures WHERE election_year = 2026 AND candidate_name <> 'Bettis, Shawn'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT spender_id) AS n_id, COUNT(DISTINCT spender_name) AS n_name FROM fec.independent_expenditures WHERE candidate_id = 'S6TX00479' AND election_year = 2026
